youtube_title: Why Does EVERY App Want Your Contacts? #Shorts
youtube_description:
They're Tricking You #2. Every new app asks to access your contacts first. Reason 1 is growth: apps use your contacts to send invites to your friends and grow their user list. And when you tap allow, your friends' numbers go to the company too, without anyone asking them. Worst case: some fake loan apps took contacts and made threat calls to borrowers' family and friends, which is why from 2023 Google Play blocked personal loan apps from accessing contacts and photos.
The fix: think before you tap allow. A chat app needs contacts; a torch app doesn't. Go to Settings and remove permissions apps don't need.
Source: Google Play personal loan app policy (2023).

Har naya app pehle yahi maangta hai: 'Allow contacts' 📱 Kyun?
Growth — tumhare contacts se dosto ko invite. Aur tumne allow kiya toh dosto ke numbers bhi company ke paas, unse pooche bina. Kuch fake loan apps ne contacts leke ghar-waalon ko dhamki bhare calls kiye — isliye Google ne 2023 se loan apps ka contacts/photos access band kiya. Fix: soch ke Allow karo, Settings mein faltu permissions hatao.
